author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
What if we took a floating ice sheet in the middle of the ocean with only 400 people and a few polar bears and turned it into a mighty nation! Welcome to greenland arguably the worst nation to live in at the start of EU5 and yet here we are ready to take them on a world wide adventure of colonising America! 

That's right, ITS AN EU5 LIVESTREAM! The spiffing brit today finally gets to show off some gameplay and invade the world to secure an endless supply of tea! Get ready for overpowered exploits and cheese! The Spiffing brit (me) has been given access to the new EU5 DLC Across the Pillars to mess about with and in that system I have been breaking the game with exploits to create some fun situations!

In this live stream the spiffing brit attempts to play tall as the nation of greenland a tiny micro nation that starts with a population of just 400. We are going to exploit the Ask For Money mechanic of Europa Universalis 5 to generate far too much money and be able to control the know
title: Creating THE WORST PLACE To Live (GREENLAND) - EU5 Is A Perfectly Balanced Game #live
